label: positive
description: New storage variable feeBps is inserted between the existing variables totalDeposits and feeRecipient in a UUPS contract deployed behind an ERC1967Proxy; feeRecipient shifts down one slot.
why_labeled: In an upgraded implementation the proxy's existing storage for feeRecipient would be read as feeBps and vice versa — a live slot collision. The contract is provably behind a proxy (VaultFactory deploys it via ERC1967Proxy), so exclusion 3c.3 does not apply. Identical to N3c-01 except for variable placement.
